prompt: Illustrate a horizontal glass "window" or frame stretching across the image, subdivided into a long sequence of small uniform tiles (tokens), with the leftmost tiles depicting the start of a project — architectural blueprints or foundational code — and the tiles progressing rightward through a timeline of related material: snippets of code, chat bubbles, a research paper's pages, project notes — all visibly present and connected within the frame. On one side, label the frame's total span "1,000,000 tokens ≈ hundreds of thousands of words" to show scale. Inside the frame, at a point near the right edge, place a small AI model icon (a simple chip or head silhouette) with faint dotted lines reaching backward to a few of the earliest tiles, showing it "seeing" and referencing that early material while working on the newest tile. To convey the caveat, show a couple of tiles far in the past rendered slightly faded or blurred, with one dotted line breaking before it reaches them — indicating that even within a large window, some earlier information can be lost or handled unreliably.
